item.text:
**REJECT**

1. **The name-read instrumentation misses QName comparisons that reread source bytes.** `NameWork` counts loads made through `scan_name` ([stream.rs:338–345](/Users/megasoft78/Desktop/Freelance/vexel/.worktrees/rust2-xml-tokenizer/rust/crates/vexel-xml/src/stream.rs:338)), but PI target classification reads the name again via `slice` and `eq_ignore_ascii_case` ([stream.rs:237](/Users/megasoft78/Desktop/Freelance/vexel/.worktrees/rust2-xml-tokenizer/rust/crates/vexel-xml/src/stream.rs:237)). End-name matching also compares source-backed slices ([stream.rs:264](/Users/megasoft78/Desktop/Freelance/vexel/.worktrees/rust2-xml-tokenizer/rust/crates/vexel-xml/src/stream.rs:264)). The new per-step assertions therefore do not measure all actual name-source reads ([stream_tests.rs:17–23](/Users/megasoft78/Desktop/Freelance/vexel/.worktrees/rust2-xml-tokenizer/rust/crates/vexel/src/stream_tests.rs:17)). **Repair:** include these reads in instrumentation or avoid rereading the names; assert the one-byte limit on PI classification and matching end names.

The persistent UTF-8 decoder, QName classification cache, partial-boundary cancellation cases, and 2/3/4-byte name coverage are present. Earlier reader assertions remain in [tests.rs](/Users/megasoft78/Desktop/Freelance/vexel/.worktrees/rust2-xml-tokenizer/rust/crates/vexel-xml/src/tests.rs:75). I did not run tests or builds.
